# Service Section Module
---

```{r}
#| label: service-setup
#| include: false

# Load service data if it exists
if (!exists("service") || is.null(service)) {
  service <- NULL
}
```

```{r}
#| label: service-html
#| output: asis
#| eval: !expr is_html

if (exists("service") && !is.null(service) && nrow(service) > 0) {
  cat('## Service\n\n')
  
  # Get column names to work with actual data
  col_names <- names(service)
  
  # Separate by service_type if the column exists
  if ("service_type" %in% col_names) {
    # Academic Service
    academic_service <- service %>% 
      filter(service_type == "Academic" | service_type == "academic")
    
    if (nrow(academic_service) > 0) {
      cat('### Academic Service\n\n')
      
      for (i in 1:nrow(academic_service)) {
        # Extract whatever columns exist
        role <- if("role" %in% col_names && !is.na(academic_service$role[i])) {
          academic_service$role[i]
        } else if("title" %in% col_names && !is.na(academic_service$title[i])) {
          academic_service$title[i]
        } else ""
        
        org <- if("organization" %in% col_names && !is.na(academic_service$organization[i])) {
          academic_service$organization[i]
        } else if("institution" %in% col_names && !is.na(academic_service$institution[i])) {
          academic_service$institution[i]
        } else ""
        
        year <- if("year" %in% col_names && !is.na(academic_service$year[i])) {
          as.character(academic_service$year[i])
        } else if("years" %in% col_names && !is.na(academic_service$years[i])) {
          academic_service$years[i]
        } else ""
        
        if (role != "" || org != "") {
          cat(paste0('<div class="service-item">\n'))
          if (role != "") cat(paste0('<strong>', role, '</strong>'))
          if (org != "") cat(paste0(', ', org))
          if (year != "") cat(paste0(' (', year, ')'))
          cat('\n</div>\n\n')
        }
      }
    }
    
    # Professional Service
    professional_service <- service %>% 
      filter(service_type == "Professional" | service_type == "professional")
    
    if (nrow(professional_service) > 0) {
      cat('### Professional Service\n\n')
      
      for (i in 1:nrow(professional_service)) {
        # Extract whatever columns exist
        role <- if("role" %in% col_names && !is.na(professional_service$role[i])) {
          professional_service$role[i]
        } else if("title" %in% col_names && !is.na(professional_service$title[i])) {
          professional_service$title[i]
        } else ""
        
        org <- if("organization" %in% col_names && !is.na(professional_service$organization[i])) {
          professional_service$organization[i]
        } else if("institution" %in% col_names && !is.na(professional_service$institution[i])) {
          professional_service$institution[i]
        } else ""
        
        year <- if("year" %in% col_names && !is.na(professional_service$year[i])) {
          as.character(professional_service$year[i])
        } else if("years" %in% col_names && !is.na(professional_service$years[i])) {
          professional_service$years[i]
        } else ""
        
        if (role != "" || org != "") {
          cat(paste0('<div class="service-item">\n'))
          if (role != "") cat(paste0('<strong>', role, '</strong>'))
          if (org != "") cat(paste0(', ', org))
          if (year != "") cat(paste0(' (', year, ')'))
          cat('\n</div>\n\n')
        }
      }
    }
  } else {
    # No service_type column, just list all service
    for (i in 1:nrow(service)) {
      # Similar extraction logic as above
      cat(paste0('<div class="service-item">Service entry ', i, '</div>\n\n'))
    }
  }
}
```

```{r}
#| label: service-pdf
#| output: asis
#| eval: !expr is_pdf

if (exists("service") && !is.null(service) && nrow(service) > 0) {
  # Don't print section header - it's in the main document
  
  # Get column names
  col_names <- names(service)
  
  # Separate by service_type if the column exists
  if ("service_type" %in% col_names) {
    # Academic Service
    academic_service <- service %>% 
      filter(service_type == "Academic" | service_type == "academic")
    
    if (nrow(academic_service) > 0) {
      cat("\\subsection{Academic Service}\n\n")
      
      for (i in 1:nrow(academic_service)) {
        # Extract columns
        role <- if("role" %in% col_names && !is.na(academic_service$role[i])) {
          academic_service$role[i]
        } else if("title" %in% col_names && !is.na(academic_service$title[i])) {
          academic_service$title[i]
        } else ""
        
        org <- if("organization" %in% col_names && !is.na(academic_service$organization[i])) {
          academic_service$organization[i]
        } else if("institution" %in% col_names && !is.na(academic_service$institution[i])) {
          academic_service$institution[i]
        } else ""
        
        year <- if("year" %in% col_names && !is.na(academic_service$year[i])) {
          as.character(academic_service$year[i])
        } else if("years" %in% col_names && !is.na(academic_service$years[i])) {
          academic_service$years[i]
        } else ""
        
        if (role != "") {
          cat("\\textbf{", escape_latex(role), "}", sep = "")
          if (org != "") {
            cat(", ", escape_latex(org), sep = "")
          }
          if (year != "") {
            cat(" (", year, ")", sep = "")
          }
          cat("\n\n")
        }
      }
    }
    
    # Professional Service
    professional_service <- service %>% 
      filter(service_type == "Professional" | service_type == "professional")
    
    if (nrow(professional_service) > 0) {
      cat("\\vspace{0.3cm}\\hrule\\vspace{0.3cm}\n")  # Add horizontal line
      cat("\\subsection{Professional Service}\n\n")
      
      for (i in 1:nrow(professional_service)) {
        # Extract columns
        role <- if("role" %in% col_names && !is.na(professional_service$role[i])) {
          professional_service$role[i]
        } else if("title" %in% col_names && !is.na(professional_service$title[i])) {
          professional_service$title[i]
        } else ""
        
        org <- if("organization" %in% col_names && !is.na(professional_service$organization[i])) {
          professional_service$organization[i]
        } else if("institution" %in% col_names && !is.na(professional_service$institution[i])) {
          professional_service$institution[i]
        } else ""
        
        year <- if("year" %in% col_names && !is.na(professional_service$year[i])) {
          as.character(professional_service$year[i])
        } else if("years" %in% col_names && !is.na(professional_service$years[i])) {
          professional_service$years[i]
        } else ""
        
        if (role != "") {
          cat("\\textbf{", escape_latex(role), "}", sep = "")
          if (org != "") {
            cat(", ", escape_latex(org), sep = "")
          }
          if (year != "") {
            cat(" (", year, ")", sep = "")
          }
          cat("\n\n")
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```
